Name: The Invisible Farmer
Author: vermicyde
Description:
[b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folders into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Use[/size][/b]
[size=3]You can edit settings from the title screen using the cog icon.[/size]
[size=4]
[b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/size]

Manifest.Name: The Invisible Farmer
Manifest.Description: This is a simple mod that allows the user to toggle the farmer's visibility.
